task.title: Log in without company single sign-on (SSO) integration
task.shortdesc: Use your Red Hat login to log in your Red Hat account when it is not set up to use company single sign-on (SSO) integration. This is the default instance.

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account.
Confirm that your Red Hat company account is not set up to use company SSO integration.

step.cmd: Use your browser to navigate to access.redhat.com

result.p: After a successful login, the avatar that is associated with your user account appears in the navigation bar in place of the login icon. Click the avatar for additional account information.
